gold.title: Liquid Gold & Platinum
gold.summary: Bright and burnished gold and platinum in 7%, 10%, 12% and custom purity, for glass and ceramic.
points: Rich shine, streak-free application, high durability after firing
notes: Purity 7%, 10%, 12% or made to your specification.
For glass (500 to 600°C) and ceramic third firing (760 to 830°C).
Smooth, streak-free application and even colour at lower firing temperatures.

luster.title: Liquid Lustre Colours
luster.summary: Metallic and pearl lustres with stable viscosity and an even sheen across firing cycles.
points: Stable viscosity, high coverage, consistent finish
notes: For glassware, 500 to 600°C: bright, reflective finish with clean firing.
For ceramicware, third firing 760 to 830°C: metallic sheen for decorative ware, giftware and tableware.

ceramic.title: Ceramic & Glass Colours
ceramic.summary: Imported on-glaze and glass colours for third-firing decoration, with sharp shades and high gloss.
points: On-glaze third firing 760 to 830°C, sharp shades and high gloss
Imported for purity and firing consistency
notes: Glass colours, 500 to 600°C: smooth, even application on glassware with stable firing.
On-glaze colours, third firing 760 to 830°C: sharp shades and high gloss for overglaze decoration.

inglaze.title: In-Glaze Colours
inglaze.summary: High-temperature colours that fuse into the glaze for scratch resistance and lasting depth.
